scope: Single-sequence, single-rank text backbone; no weight serialization or checkpoint API

geometry.L: positive layer count; compress_ratios has exactly L entries
geometry.A: shared latent K/V head dimension, divisible by 32
geometry.R: positive even rotary tail <= min(A, I)
geometry.G: output groups; H divisible by G
geometry.T: explicit maximum total tokens per sequence, including prefill and generation
geometry.S: exactly one shared expert, as asserted by donor MoE
geometry.U: Engram row width, divisible by 32 for donor row codec
geometry.V: exact admitted tokenizer vocabulary, 129280 for accepted artifact

layer_order: embed raw token; repeat embedding C times; initial pre_mix is one-hot copy zero
for each layer in ascending index: optional Engram write into residual copies
compute attention mHC mixes from current residual; collapse with PREVIOUS sublayer pre_mix
attention RMSNorm -> low-rank query + shared latent K/V -> local + optional compressed sparse attention -> grouped factorized O
compute FFN mHC mixes from post-attention residual; collapse with attention pre_mix
FFN RMSNorm -> routed experts plus shared expert -> FFN hc_post
pass FFN pre_mix to next layer
collapse final stream with last FFN pre_mix -> final RMSNorm -> untied output head -> logits

attention.local: q=RMSNorm(wq_a*x)*wq_b; k=v=RMSNorm(wkv*x); rotate tail; cache local K/V with E4M3/E8M0 group32 quant-dequant
attention.compression: ratio 0: local only; ratio 1: normalized projection; ratio >1: per-channel softmax pooling of wkv*x with wgate*x over completed groups, then norm
attention.sharing: latest preceding kv_source provides compressed K/V and index keys; latest index_source supplies selected positions; consumers must use the same ratio
attention.donor_decode_divergence: pinned donor Indexer rebinds shared index keys only when an owner completes a group, so its decode path scores a filling ratio>1 group against the previous owner's keys and disagrees with its own prefill path; Elpis follows the prefill/documented semantics (each owner's own keys), qualified against the unmodified donor prefill at every position
attention.indexer: index key from UNROTATED compressed latent via wk+RMSNorm; RoPE at first position of group; FP4/E8M0 group32 key/query quant-dequant; sum_heads(relu(q dot k)*weights_proj(x)/sqrt(I*J))
attention.candidate_prefilter: candidate_source scores blocks by maximum; force newest reachable block; retain candidate_topk_blocks; later index sources mask other blocks
attention.selection: top min(K, completed_groups), sorted back into position order; score ties resolved by smaller position in Elpis (donor topk tie order is unspecified)
attention.compressed_cache: rotate latent after indexer reads it; FP4/E4M3 group16 quant-dequant; completed groups only, no future tokens
attention.sparse_attention: one softmax over local plus selected compressed positions and a learned sink per head; sink has zero value; inverse RoPE on output before grouped O
attention.rope: pure SWA uses rope_theta without YaRN; compressed layers use compress_rope_theta and parametric donor YaRN
attention.state: preallocated sequence-local rings, compressor partial groups, and at most floor(T/ratio) compressed/index entries per owner

engram.map: official tokenizer single-token decode; partial UTF-8 tokens keyed by raw spelling; NFKC,NFD,StripAccents,Lowercase,space normalization with U+E000 sentinel,Strip
engram.multipliers: NumPy default_rng(10007*layer); odd int64 multipliers bounded by compressed vocabulary
engram.layout: globally unique increasing primes per n-gram head from bucket_size; packed cumulative offsets per layer
engram.hash: existing DSV41_ENGRAM value-tail arithmetic; pad is compressed map of tokenizer pad; dead sentinel blocks all older history
engram.write: concatenate (N-1)*B rows, never mean; wkv -> C keys plus one shared value; branch-local RMS dot with q_weight*k_weight; sigmoid(copysign(sqrt(max(abs(dot),1e-6)),dot)); gated additive residual
engram.storage: existing immutable FMS RowEngine; single worker; F32 materialized rows or donor E4M3/E8M0/BF16 row codec

moe.scores: linear(x, gate.weight)/gate_temp; softmax, sigmoid, or sqrt(softplus)
moe.selection: top-k(scores + gate.bias); deterministic smaller-expert-id tie break
moe.weights: unbiased selected scores; normalize only if norm_topk_prob and k>1, denominator sum+1e-20; multiply route_scale
moe.expert: gate=w1*x, up=w3*x; optional gate upper clamp and symmetric up clamp; silu(gate)*up; multiply route weight BEFORE w2 projection
moe.reduction: routed experts in ascending expert ID, then one unweighted shared expert
moe.residency: only selected experts plus shared read during execution; one expert staged at a time; all identities and content bindings verified before begin

mhc.comb: row softmax+hc_eps; column normalize with hc_eps; repeat row then column normalization sinkhorn_iters-1 times

tensor_layout.all_linear_weights: row-major [out,in], y[o]=sum_i x[i]*w[o,i]; no implicit transpose/cast in intake
tensor_layout.head: [V,D], untied
tensor_layout.kv_owner.compressor: wkv[A,D], norm[A], wgate[A,D] only when ratio>1
tensor_layout.index_source.indexer: wq_b[J*I,Q], weights_proj[J,D]; kv_owner also wk[I,A], k_norm[I]
tensor_layout.layer.mhc: attn and ffn each: fn[(2+C)*C,C*D], base[(2+C)*C], scale[3]
tensor_layout.layer.experts: each routed ID and shared: w1[F,D], w3[F,D], w2[D,F]

numerics.parameters: finite F32_LE, row-major; explicit byte lengths and digests; reject unsupported representations
numerics.arithmetic: CPU F32 einsum without BLAS optimization; single caller thread, no new pool; donor cache quantization with nearest-even finite formats
numerics.not_claimed: bitwise GPU/BF16/FP8 GEMM equivalence; packed quantized parameter intake; multi-rank execution

authority.persistent: immutable model/config/manifest/tokenizer/address identities; PrincipalState/commits; HACF context and ECS receipt history
authority.sequence_local: all attention/index/compressor/mHC scratch and address tail, per-step observations, output tokens
authority.forbidden_persistence: KV/index caches, activations and execution scratch as historical context; no learned output becomes authority
authority.finalization: release driver sequence scratch after commit/failure; receipts retain identities and bounded traces only
authority.fms: explicit admitted asset byte-range reads allowed for required associative rows and selected experts; cold-page integrity remains substrate-owned

donor_boundaries.Qwen: address/row oracles only; existing QWEN38_PLE kept separately; do not import Qwen convolution or Gemma-style norm into DSV41 Engram
donor_boundaries.ZCode: turn-scoped snapshot, causal source metadata, isolated forks and compaction boundaries already represented in Elpis; no application runtime or mid-sequence context update

fixture.requires: real V4.1 vocabulary plus all backbone paths using tiny parametric geometry
